items.title: Generalized Riemann Hypothesis proof in Lean 4, in 76k lines (down from 17M)
items.author: mikedanese
items.desc:
This is a shortened version of Alpöge's Lean proof of RH and GRH for Dirichlet L-functions (https://alpo.ge/remark.pdf), which was about 17 million lines.

There are two editions proving the same five theorems: a readable one at about 300,000 lines (start at grh/GUIDE.md) and a compact one at about 76,000.

Github repo: https://github.com/lsernau/grh-lean
